scope: Isolated original srcdoc preview. No real WidgetCard, Host Remote, repair admission, or subsequent model response is exercised.

render.reason: Document bootstrapped without a captured initial error and has visible content. This does not establish meaning, factual correctness, or functioning controls.

interaction.reason: No automatic action sequence specified for this static inspection.

localMessages.reason: No local action sequence was requested.

followupPayload.reason: No explicit follow-up requested by this scenario.

hostFollowup.reason: This preview never contacts the Host; validate real conversation delivery separately.

layout.reason: Four initial viewport/theme screenshots recorded; overflow is a review flag, not a standalone product verdict.

content.reason: Required labels were observed; values, proportions and meaning still need content review.

visibleLabels.reason: All requested literal labels are present in visible text or accessible names.
